# MuskOx Flannels

> Premium 100% cotton flannel shirts built for durability, with every purchase supporting wildlife conservation efforts.

MuskOx Flannels specializes in heavyweight, double-brushed cotton flannel shirts for men, offering multiple fits and styles. The brand donates $10 per flannel sold to wildlife conservation, partnering with organizations like the Alaska Wildlife Conservation Center.

## Key Topics

- Grand Flannel
- Field Grand Flannel
- 100% cotton heavyweight flannel
- Double-brushed fabric
- Classic fit
- Relaxed fit
- Tall fit
- Flannel jackets
- Wildlife conservation
- Portuguese cotton
- Best sellers
- Color variants
- Men's clothing
- Ethically-sourced materials
- Made in USA
